T2_hero.h1: Liquichek Serum Indices — hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia controls
T2_hero.lead: Bio-Rad control materials for checking how an analyzer detects hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia in samples.

T3_about.text: Liquichek Serum Indices is a Bio-Rad control material range for monitoring analyzer detection of hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia in samples. It includes individual interferents and non-interfered material based on human-source serum. The range is intended for evaluating instrument response during pre-analytical monitoring.

rows.label: Intended use
rows.value: Monitors instrument detection of hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia (HIL) interferences

items.text: The materials help evaluate instrument response to hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia during pre-analytical monitoring.
After opening, material is stable for 14 days at 2–8 °C, while a frozen aliquot is stable for 28 days at −20 to −70 °C, according to the manufacturer.

T10_faq.h2: Liquichek Serum Indices: questions and answers

items.q: What is Liquichek Serum Indices used for?
items.a: It is used to monitor how an analyzer detects hemolysis, icterus, and lipemia in samples.

items.q: Which materials are available in the range?
items.a: The range includes Hemolysis, Icterus, Lipemia, and Non-interfered materials. These materials are also available in MiniPak formats.

items.q: How should Liquichek Serum Indices be stored after opening?
items.a: After opening, the material is stable for 14 days at 2–8 °C, according to the manufacturer.

items.q: Who supplies Liquichek Serum Indices in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply and application support.
